scripts.clean:ports: kill -15 $(lsof -tiTCP:4000 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null || true; kill -15 $(lsof -tiTCP:8081 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null || true; kill -15 $(lsof -tiTCP:19000 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:api:clean: npm run clean:ports && npm --workspace apps/api run dev
scripts.dev:phone:go: npm run clean:ports && /bin/zsh -lc 'npm --workspace apps/api run dev & API_PID=$!; npm --workspace apps/mobile run start:phone:lan; kill -15 $API_PID 2>/dev/null || true'
